# RFC Template

## Summary

Describe the proposal in one or two paragraphs.

## Context

Explain the current state and constraints.

## Proposal

Describe the recommended approach.

## Alternatives

Compare viable alternatives and trade-offs.

## Impact

Describe API, domain, testing, operational, and documentation impact.

## Rollout

Describe sequencing, validation, and rollback.

## Decision

Record the accepted outcome or next step.
